title: Support MP4 VobSub extraction staging
summary: Add MP4-family embedded VobSub extraction support by staging the selected subtitle stream into a temporary Matroska file before the existing MKVToolNix IDX/SUB extraction and OCR flow.
reason: Recent failure markers showed MP4 sources with embedded VobSub tracks were rejected as unsupported before OCR could run, even though the existing pipeline can OCR VobSub once it has an IDX/SUB pair.
behavior_before: Embedded VobSub extraction failed for MP4-family inputs with SUBTITLE_VOBSUB_EXTRACT_UNSUPPORTED_CONTAINER because only Matroska-family inputs were allowed into the mkvextract path.
behavior_after: MP4-family embedded VobSub tracks are staged through FFmpeg into a temporary Matroska file, then processed by the existing mkvextract and VobSub OCR path. Unsupported non-MP4, non-Matroska containers still fail closed.
